The Samsung Galaxy Watch is a smartwatch developed by Samsung Electronics. It was announced on August 9, 2018.[1][2][3][4][5][6][7][8][9] The Galaxy Watch was scheduled for availability in the United States starting on August 24, 2018, at select carriers and retail locations in South Korea on August 31, 2018, and in additional select markets on September 14, 2018.[10]

On February 27, 2021, Shortly after the Galaxy Watch Active 2 and Watch 3 received an update unlocking the ECG feature for the European countries, Samsung is now delivering Galaxy Watch3-intrinsic features to the original Galaxy Watch and Watch Active.[11]
